latest.author_name: 毒猫猫 | 量化摸鱼师
latest.text:
对 Hydrogen 的第一印象：确实很快，即便是 thinking level high 在客户端里面也是秒出。很聪明，继承了 Carbon / Argon 的灵活性，而且说话不罗嗦，这点非常好

另外暂时没有遇到奇怪的八股文（恐怖极其人啥的），可能是用的还不够多

说到价格：API 定价是 DeepSeek 的 5x（峰）/ 10x（谷）。但 benchmark 上的 per task cost 大约只比 ds 高 20%~30%。据说是因为做长任务的时候每一步的正确率更高，所以可以用更少的 token 解决问题

quote.text:
Following Carbon + Argon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence to everyone. Built for speed and efficiency for everyday tasks, coding and agentic workflows.

Compared to 3.8 Flash, it finishes tasks 2.5x faster. Also has 4 thinking levels, so you only wait and pay for the reasoning depth a task requires.

Rolling out today to all tiers of @GoogleAIStudio, the Gemini API, @GeminiApp, Search and paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google @Antigravity.
